newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA BNR WITHDRAWS TWO PRIVATE BANKS' LICENCES.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA BNR WITHDRAWS TWO PRIVATE BANKS' LICENCES.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Monday it had withdrawn the banking licences of private banks Dacia Felix and Credit Bank after a deterioration of their financial position, paving the way for their liquidation.

"Their financial position has deteriorated following the high level of debts to creditors, the large share of credit portfolios of uncorresponding quality and the low level of capitalisation," a BNR statement said.
It said the withdrawal decision had been reached by the BNR board according to provisions under a law on banking activities and in line with BNR rules on banking licences.
